# Degree Unlocker
> Degree Unlocker is a high-performance, accessible academic workstation and learning companion designed for students, high schoolers, and lifelong learners.

## Features
- **Smart Note Taking & Cornell Method**: Structured academic note-taking with automatic summaries, key keywords, and interactive mind maps.
- **SRS Flashcards & Spaced Repetition**: Leitner-style active recall flashcards with mastery tracking.
- **Interactive Quizzes & Exams**: Self-testing mode with instant grading, step-by-step solutions, and error analysis.
- **Accessible & Compliant**: Full WCAG 2.1 AA / ADA accessibility, screen-reader optimized, high contrast, keyboard navigation, and European GDPR data protection (15+ digital age verification).
- **Zero-Data Sell**: No advertising tracking, local-first offline storage (IndexedDB) with optional encrypted cloud backup.
